## Ryanair Cabin Baggage & Underseat Dimensions (AIRLINES)
- Canonical Link: https://Thorlan04.github.io/global-compatibility-matrix-agent/en/ryanair-cabin-baggage-dimensions.html
- Summary: Official Ryanair baggage dimensions: 40x20x25 cm (15.7x7.8x9.8 in) underseat bag and 55x40x20 cm (21.6x15.7x7.8 in) 10kg priority cabin trolley.

### Exact Specifications (Dual Units):
* **Free Underseat Personal Item**: Metric: `40 x 20 x 25 cm` | Imperial: `15.7 x 7.8 x 9.8 in` (Must fit strictly under the seat in front of you without forcing)
* **Priority 10kg Overhead Cabin Bag**: Metric: `55 x 40 x 20 cm (Max 10 kg)` | Imperial: `21.6 x 15.7 x 7.8 in (Max 22 lbs)` (Includes wheels and handles in Ryanair sizer)
* **Lithium Power Banks & Spare Batteries**: Metric: `Max 100 Wh (Max 160 Wh with approval)` | Imperial: `Max 27,000 mAh at 3.7V` (Never place lithium battery power banks in checked baggage)

### Verified Amazon Multi-Store Purchase Links:

## LG OLED C3 & C4 (42 to 83 inch) VESA Mount & Screw Dimensions (HARDWARE)
- Canonical Link: https://Thorlan04.github.io/global-compatibility-matrix-agent/en/lg-oled-c3-c4-vesa-mount-power.html
- Summary: Exact VESA patterns: 300x200 mm for 42", 48", 55", 65" and 400x400 mm for 77", 83". Exact screw size: M6 with 12-16 mm thread engagement.

### Exact Specifications (Dual Units):
* **LG OLED C3/C4 42-inch VESA & Screws**: Metric: `VESA 300 x 200 mm (M6 screws, 12-14 mm depth)` | Imperial: `11.8 x 7.8 in (M6 screws, 0.47-0.55 in depth)` (Weight without stand: 9.8 kg (21.6 lbs))
* **LG OLED C3/C4 55 & 65-inch VESA & Screws**: Metric: `VESA 300 x 200 mm (M6 screws, 12-16 mm depth)` | Imperial: `11.8 x 7.8 in (M6 screws, 0.47-0.63 in depth)` (Weight: 55" = 14.1 kg (31.1 lbs), 65" = 16.6 kg (36.6 lbs))
* **LG OLED C3/C4 77 & 83-inch VESA & Screws**: Metric: `VESA 400 x 400 mm (77"), 400 x 400 mm (83") (M6 screws)` | Imperial: `15.7 x 15.7 in (M6 screws)` (Weight: 77" = 23.5 kg (51.8 lbs), 83" = 32.3 kg (71.2 lbs))

## Tesla Model Y Wiper Blades, Roof Rack & Cargo Dimensions (AUTO)
- Canonical Link: https://Thorlan04.github.io/global-compatibility-matrix-agent/en/tesla-model-y-wipers-roof-trunk-dimensions.html
- Summary: Exact fit specs: Wipers 650 mm (26") + 475 mm (19") pinch tab, Roof rack rating 68 kg (150 lbs), Trunk liner 108 x 105 cm (42.5 x 41.3").

### Exact Specifications (Dual Units):
* **Front Windshield Wiper Blades (Driver + Passenger)**: Metric: `650 mm (Driver) + 475 mm (Passenger) [Pinch Tab 19mm]` | Imperial: `26 inches (Driver) + 19 inches (Passenger)` (Pinch tab push button connector (slim top lock))
* **Glass Roof Rack Max Dynamic Load**: Metric: `Max 68 kg (150 lbs) dynamic load rating` | Imperial: `150 lbs max dynamic load rating` (Attaches to hidden mounting arrow indicators under glass edge)
* **Rear Trunk & Sub-Trunk Liner Cargo Dimensions**: Metric: `Trunk Floor: 108 cm wide x 105 cm deep (854 L volume)` | Imperial: `Trunk Floor: 42.5 in wide x 41.3 in deep (30.2 cu ft)` (Deep sub-trunk well: 63 x 40 x 30 cm (24.8 x 15.7 x 11.8 in))

### Verified Amazon Multi-Store Purchase Links:

## EasyJet (AIRLINES)
- Canonical Link: https://Thorlan04.github.io/global-compatibility-matrix-agent/en/easyjet-baggage-powerbank-guide.html
- Summary: Comprehensive guide to EasyJet's cabin baggage allowances, including underseat and overhead bags, and power bank regulations for a smooth journey.

### Exact Specifications (Dual Units):
* **Small Cabin Bag (Underseat)**: Metric: `45 x 36 x 20 cm` | Imperial: `17.7 x 14.2 x 7.9 in` (Included for all passengers. Must fit under the seat in front of you. No specific weight limit, but must be able to lift it yourself.)
* **Large Cabin Bag (Overhead)**: Metric: `56 x 45 x 25 cm (Max 15 kg)` | Imperial: `22.0 x 17.7 x 9.8 in (Max 33 lbs)` (Requires Up Front or Extra Legroom seat, easyJet Plus card, or FLEXI fare. Stored in overhead locker.)
* **Power Bank (Up to 100 Wh)**: Metric: `Max 100 Wh` | Imperial: `Max 100 Wh` (Must be carried in cabin baggage only. No airline approval required. Typically corresponds to 27,000 mAh at 3.7V.)
* **Power Bank (101-160 Wh)**: Metric: `101-160 Wh (Max 2 per passenger)` | Imperial: `101-160 Wh (Max 2 per passenger)` (Requires airline approval. Must be carried in cabin baggage only. Max 2 per passenger. Typically corresponds to 27,001 - 43,243 mAh at 3.7V.)
* **Power Bank (Over 160 Wh)**: Metric: `Over 160 Wh` | Imperial: `Over 160 Wh` (Not permitted on board as cabin or checked baggage under any circumstances.)

### Verified Amazon Multi-Store Purchase Links:
* 🇺🇸 United States: https://www.amazon.com/s?k=easyjet+underseat+bag+45x36x20%2C+easyjet+cabin+bag+56x45x25&tag=autocompat-21
* 🇬🇧 United Kingdom: https://www.amazon.co.uk/s?k=easyjet+underseat+bag+45x36x20%2C+easyjet+cabin+bag+56x45x25&tag=autocompat-21
* 🇨🇦 Canada: https://www.amazon.ca/s?k=easyjet+underseat+bag+45x36x20%2C+easyjet+cabin+bag+56x45x25&tag=autocompat-21
* 🇦🇺 Australia: https://www.amazon.com.au/s?k=easyjet+underseat+bag+45x36x20%2C+easyjet+cabin+bag+56x45x25&tag=autocompat-21
